It's been about a year since we last looked at Tala, so I figured it was time to give them another try! I have had a very hit or miss relationship with this brand since their very first launch. Some pieces are incredible, some fit oddly, and their company ethos seems SO important at times and less so other times. They claim to be all about sustainability, but have recently accelerated their launch schedule to the point where there have been 2 launches announced since I filmed this video last week. They claim to care about size inclusivity, but many of their launches only go to an XL and their instagram page is filled with size XS pilates girls exclusively. Very confusing for sure! I also had a bizarre shipping experience this time which I talked about at length in the video if you are interested! 

Today I decided to try a few of their different activewear collections, including the new Sculpt Seamless and Dayflex collections. I have also reviewed their Skinluxe, 365, and Swim collections in previous videos if you are interested in those! I typically always size up to a Large in Tala products. For reference I am usually a US size 10 or Medium in bottoms and 34DDD for bras. I am 5'1", so I opt for the shortest length in bottoms where possible!
